name: Ferraro Foods of North Carolina
old_description: EXCLUSIVE BRANDS AND PRODUCTS DESIGNED WITH OUR CUSTOMERS IN MIND
about:
Ferraro Foods traces its roots to 1975, when founder Ferraro established the business in Greenbrook, New Jersey. Named after its original owner, the company began as an Italian-focused food distributor with a mission to deliver quality products and reliable service. Today the operation is headquartered in Mebane, North Carolina.

The company operates as a broad-line foodservice distributor, stocking thousands of items that range from pasta, premium cheeses, and tomatoes to flour, beverages, meats, seafood, appetizers, desserts, and packaging such as pizza boxes and food containers. Its logistics network includes multi-temperature trucks and refrigerated loading docks designed to maintain product integrity across the supply chain. Ferraro Foods serves more than 8,000 customers across 26 states.

Its customer base spans a variety of foodservice operators, including restaurants, institutional kitchens, and other businesses that require consistent access to Italian and specialty food products. The distributor also offers an online ordering platform and publishes a monthly product bulletin called FRESCO to highlight new additions.

Ferraro Foods emphasizes product integrity and reliable delivery as its core differentiators, stating that every piece of equipment from loading dock to truck is held to the same high standards to meet customer expectations.
